name: Kewen Kong
evidence: CSV spelling 'Ke-Wen Kong' is wrong; arXiv HTML of 2411.06032v1 prints 'Kewen Kong *', Schwarzman College, Tsinghua University, Beijing. Identity corroborated by Columbia ICLS/Columbia College news: 'ICLS Concentrator Kewen Kong Receives Schwarzman Scholarship', Kewen Kong CC'23, comparative literature and Italian, Class of 2024 Schwarzman Scholar at Tsinghua - same cohort as the paper. Two LinkedIn queries (site:linkedin.com/in "Kewen Kong" with and without Schwarzman/Tsinghua terms) returned no profile for him, only near-name homonyms (Kewen Qi, Kewen Qu, Kewen Hu, Kelvin Kong), all rejected. ResearchGate site: search likewise returned only homonyms (Kewen Wang, Kenny Kong, Kenneth Kong). No email printed in the paper and no other arXiv paper under this name.
